verdict.rationale: Loops documents a broad API covering contacts, events, transactional email, campaigns, content, themes and workflows. It adds an OpenAPI spec, a CLI and an MCP server, and API-authored content stays in sync with the visual editor. However, its own docs say campaigns are created as drafts via the API and then reviewed and sent from the dashboard, so full UI parity is not delivered. Missing for 10: API sending of campaigns, documented API coverage of segments, domain setup and team/account settings, and independent confirmation of API–UI parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The Loops API lets you manage contacts, send events and transactional email, and create and manage campaigns, email content, themes, and workflows.
Create draft campaigns, content and all, straight from the API. Review and send from the dashboard.
Create and update workflow graphs, change mailing lists, and add, branch, edit, or delete nodes from code.
Author programmatically with the Content API, then keep editing visually in Loops, and both stay in sync.
Use the OpenAPI spec for toolchains, validation, and client generation.
